panel_title: AI in Action at Con Edison

use_cases.title: Welcome & Opening Remarks
use_cases.script: Good morning everyone, and a warm welcome to Con Edison Tech Day! I am thrilled to be your moderator today for our featured showcase: AI in Action at Con Edison. This morning, our Business and Enterprise Technology Solutions teams have partnered to bring you five transformative artificial intelligence capabilities already powering our energy grid, our workforce, and our customer experience across New York City and Westchester.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce the panel with cheerful, high-energy professionalism.

use_cases.title: Customer Operations & Generative Billing Agent
use_cases.script: Let us begin with Customer Operations. I would like to welcome Patrick Hooper and his team. They are deploying an intelligent, conversational generative AI billing agent that analyzes complex billing histories, explains seasonal rate variances in clear plain English, and proactively suggests tailored payment agreements, dramatically reducing wait times for New York families.
use_cases.prompt: Highlight the billing agent and Patrick Hooper's customer operations impact.

use_cases.title: Fleet Vehicle Idling Reduction AI
use_cases.script: Moving to our clean urban environment, our next showcase tackles fleet sustainability. Operating thousands of utility bucket trucks across dense city streets requires continuous field readiness. Our Fleet and ETS engineering teams deployed computer vision and telematics AI that detects unnecessary idling in real time, conserving thousands of gallons of fuel and reducing greenhouse gas emissions across all five boroughs.
use_cases.prompt: Explain the vehicle idling reduction initiative and urban emissions savings.

use_cases.title: Subsurface Manhole Safety & Predictive Acoustics
use_cases.script: Safety is always our highest priority at Con Edison. Our third use case focuses on underground infrastructure protection. By combining Internet of Things sensors inside manhole structures with edge AI acoustic pattern recognition, our systems can detect subtle frequency anomalies and thermal pre-conditions hours before an event occurs, keeping our workers and pedestrians safe.
use_cases.prompt: Detail how acoustic and thermal AI monitors manholes for subsurface safety.

use_cases.title: Severe Weather Modeling & Grid Resilience
use_cases.script: Next, let us turn to weather modeling and grid resilience. Please join me in welcoming Tom Langlois. Tom and the ETS analytics team have integrated hyper-local microclimate predictive models that simulate wind shear, coastal storm surge, and wet snow load at neighborhood-level granularity, allowing our dispatch centers to preposition repair crews before storms make landfall.
use_cases.prompt: Introduce Tom Langlois and discuss high-resolution predictive storm modeling.

use_cases.title: Customer Energy Solutions & Clean Heat AI
use_cases.script: Our final use case demonstrates our commitment to New York's clean energy transition. Con Edison's Customer Energy Solutions team is leveraging AI recommendation models to help residential and commercial property owners optimize heat pump conversions, calculate building carbon footprints, and automate smart EV charging to align with off-peak grid capacity.
use_cases.prompt: Highlight customer energy solutions, building heat pump adoption, and EV load balancing.

use_cases.title: Audience & Panel Q&A
use_cases.script: Thank you to all of our incredible presenters! We now invite questions from our audience. You may ask me any question about these AI deployments, our technical architectures, or how business and technology collaborate here at Con Edison.
use_cases.prompt: Transition warmly into the live audience Q&A session.
